newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai rubber prices ease as Japan stocks stay high.
newsitem.headline: Thai rubber prices ease as Japan stocks stay high.

text.p: Thai rubber prices for both short- and longer-term contracts dropped in a quiet market as buying interest waned, traders said on Friday.
Japanese buying interest was scant as rubber stocks levels remained high in that country. Chinese buyers were sidelined as the current prices were considered too high, they added.
Thai benchmark RSS3 for October shipment was quoted this week at US$1.26/kg FOB Bangkok from around $1.28/kg last week.
December/January delivery dipped to $1.27-$1.28/kg FOB Bangkok compared with $1.29-$1.30/kg a week earlier.
Some expected the market to continue to be bearish next week amid subdued demand.
"People are watching the stocks in Japan closely to see where it would go," said one Hatyai trader.
